title: The Metamorphosis
author: Franz Kafka
genres: Classic, Absurdist Fiction, Literature, Novella, Philosophy
description: One morning, Gregor Samsa wakes from troubled dreams to find himself transformed in his bed into a monstrous insect-like creature, forcing his family to confront their isolation, alienation, and grotesque absurdity.

title: The Trial
author: Franz Kafka
genres: Classic, Absurdist Fiction, Literature, Dystopian, Philosophy
description: Josef K., a respectable bank officer, is suddenly arrested and prosecuted by an inaccessible and bizarre judicial authority, with the nature of his crime never revealed to him in an impenetrable bureaucratic nightmare.

title: The Castle
author: Franz Kafka
genres: Classic, Absurdist Fiction, Literature, Psychological, Philosophy
description: A land surveyor known only as K. arrives in a snowbound village governed by an enigmatic, inaccessible bureaucracy headquartered in a castle overlooking the town.

title: Letters to Milena
author: Franz Kafka
genres: Memoir, Letters, Non-Fiction, Romance, Philosophy
description: Kafka's passionate, desperate, and agonizing love letters to Milena Jesenska, revealing his deepest psychological vulnerabilities, intellectual brilliance, and haunting self-doubts.

title: In the Penal Colony
author: Franz Kafka
genres: Classic, Absurdist Fiction, Horror, Novella, Philosophy
description: An explorer witnesses the gruesome ritual execution apparatus on an island penal colony, examining justice, cruelty, obsolete tradition, and institutional dogmatism.

author: George Orwell
genres: Dystopian, Classic, Political Fiction, Literature
description: Winston Smith lives in a totalitarian society monitored by the all-seeing Big Brother, where independent thought is outlawed and the Ministry of Truth rewrites history.

title: Animal Farm
author: George Orwell
genres: Classic, Satire, Political Fiction, Literature
description: A timeless allegorical novella detailing the revolution of farm animals against their human master, only to see power corrupt their new leader pig Napoleon.

title: Homage to Catalonia
author: George Orwell
genres: Non-Fiction, History, Memoir, War, Political
description: Orwell's firsthand account of fighting alongside socialist and anti-fascist militia in the Spanish Civil War, experiencing revolution, trench warfare, and betrayal.

title: Down and Out in Paris and London
author: George Orwell
genres: Memoir, Non-Fiction, Biography, Social Commentary, Classic
description: A visceral memoir documenting extreme poverty, survival in squalid hotel kitchens in Paris, and life among tramps on the roads of London.

title: Burmese Days
author: George Orwell
genres: Classic, Historical Fiction, Political Fiction, Literature
description: Based on Orwell's years in the Indian Imperial Police in Burma, exposing the corruption, racism, and disillusionment at the tail end of the British Empire.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
genres: Classic, Philosophical Fiction, Literature, Psychological
description: Impoverished former student Raskolnikov commits a calculated murder in Saint Petersburg, followed by a relentless mental ordeal of guilt, fevered paranoia, and spiritual redemption.

title: The Brothers Karamazov
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
genres: Classic, Philosophical Fiction, Literature, Family Drama
description: A passionate philosophical novel that enters into ethical debates of God, free will, and morality through the turbulent lives of three brothers and the murder of their father.

title: Notes from Underground
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
genres: Classic, Philosophical Fiction, Existentialism, Literature, Psychological
description: The cynical diary of an alienated, bitter former civil servant living in Saint Petersburg, offering a devastating critique of rational utopianism, determinism, and human spite.

title: The Idiot
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
genres: Classic, Philosophical Fiction, Literature, Psychological Drama
description: Prince Myshkin, a gentle, saintly, and guileless epileptic nobleman, returns to Russian society only to have his pure goodness clash tragically with corruption, jealousy, and greed.

title: Demons (The Possessed)
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
genres: Classic, Philosophical Fiction, Political Drama, Literature
description: A terrifying prophetic examination of radical revolutionary nihilism in a provincial Russian town, plotting conspiracy, murder, and moral decay.

title: White Nights
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
genres: Classic, Romance, Literature, Novella, Psychological
description: A lonely, dreamy narrator wanders the luminous summer twilight of Saint Petersburg and falls in unrequited love with a distressed young woman across four magical nights.

title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
author: Robert C. Martin
genres: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Programming, Tech
description: Even bad code can function. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees. Uncle Bob presents a revolutionary paradigm on how to write readable, maintainable, and robust code.

title: The Clean Coder: A Code of Conduct for Professional Programmers
author: Robert C. Martin
genres: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Career, Tech
description: Practical advice about the discipline, standards, ethics, and practices of true software craftsmanship, from time management to estimates, coding, refactoring, and testing.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer: Your Journey to Mastery
author: David Thomas, Andrew Hunt
genres: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Programming, Tech
description: One of the most significant books in modern software engineering. Cuts through the increasing specialization and technicalities to examine the core process of crafting flexible and working software.

title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides
genres: Computer Science, Software Architecture, Programming, Tech
description: Captures 23 classic software design patterns that solve recurring problems in object-oriented design, defining terminology and blueprints used across the computing industry.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
genres: Computer Science, Distributed Systems, Database, Tech, Architecture
description: An exhaustive, indispensable deep-dive into the principles and tradeoffs of data systems, databases, distributed transactions, consensus algorithms, streaming, and batch processing.

title: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS)
author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest, Clifford Stein
genres: Computer Science, Algorithms, Mathematics, Academia, Tech
description: The definitive comprehensive guide and textbook covering algorithms, data structures, graph theory, dynamic programming, and computational complexity.

title: Grokking Algorithms: An Illustrated Guide
author: Aditya Bhargava
genres: Computer Science, Algorithms, Programming, Education, Tech
description: A fully illustrated, friendly guide that teaches you how to apply common algorithms to practical problems like search, sorting, graphs, and dynamic programming.

title: Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code
author: Martin Fowler
genres: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Programming, Tech
description: Explains the principles of refactoring software, identifying code smells, and step-by-step techniques to improve internal code structure without changing observable behavior.

title: Code Complete: A Practical Handbook of Software Construction
author: Steve McConnell
genres: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Programming, Tech
description: Synthesizes effective software engineering practices into clear, pragmatic guidance for creating high-quality code, defensive programming, and architecture.

title: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs (SICP)
author: Harold Abelson, Gerald Jay Sussman
genres: Computer Science, Programming, Lisp, Academia, Tech
description: The legendary MIT introductory computer science text teaching the deep conceptual foundations of computation, abstraction, interpreters, and metalinguistic abstraction using Scheme/Lisp.

title: You Don't Know JS: Scope & Closures
author: Kyle Simpson
genres: Computer Science, JavaScript, Web Development, Programming, Tech
description: An in-depth look at JavaScript's lexical scope, lexical this, function scopes, block scopes, and closures, uncovering the exact runtime mechanics of the language.

title: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow
author: Aurelien Geron
genres: Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Python, Data Science, Tech
description: Through concrete examples, minimal theory, and production-ready Python frameworks, this book shows you how to build intelligent systems using linear models, random forests, and deep neural networks.

title: Deep Learning
author: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
genres: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Academia, Tech
description: The definitive textbook on deep learning, introducing mathematical concepts in linear algebra and probability before covering modern feedforward nets, convolutional networks, and generative models.

title: Code: The Hidden Language of Computer Hardware and Software
author: Charles Petzold
genres: Computer Science, Hardware, History of Computing, Electronics, Tech
description: A brilliant, poetic, and accessible journey through flashlights, telegraphs, logic gates, binary relays, and microprocessors to show how humans created modern computers from simple mechanisms.

title: Computer Systems: A Programmer's Perspective (CS:APP)
author: Randal E. Bryant, David R. O'Hallaron
genres: Computer Science, Systems Programming, Assembly, Memory Architecture, Tech
description: Explains the underlying hardware, machine-level representations, compiler optimizations, processor architectures, memory hierarchies, virtual memory, and system-level I/O from a programmer's viewpoint.

title: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces (OSTEP)
author: Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau, Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau
genres: Computer Science, Operating Systems, Concurrency, Virtualization, Tech
description: An engaging and rigorous textbook dissecting the fundamental pillars of operating systems: virtualization (CPU and memory), concurrency (threads and locks), and persistence (file systems and RAID).

title: System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide
author: Alex Xu
genres: Computer Science, System Design, Distributed Systems, Software Engineering, Tech
description: A visual and practical roadmap with real-world architectural blueprints for scaling systems: rate limiters, key-value stores, distributed message queues, chat systems, search indexers, and YouTube-scale CDNs.

title: Database Internals: A Deep Dive into Distributed Systems
author: Alex Petrov
genres: Computer Science, Database, Distributed Systems, Storage Engines, Tech
description: Examines the low-level engine mechanics of modern relational and NoSQL storage systems: B-trees, LSM-trees, write-ahead logs, Raft consensus, two-phase commit, and distributed coordination.

title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (AIMA)
author: Stuart Russell, Peter Norvig
genres: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, Tech
description: The world's leading universal textbook on artificial intelligence, introducing rational agents, heuristic search, constraint satisfaction, probabilistic reasoning, reinforcement learning, and neural nets.

title: Fluent Python: Clear, Concise, and Effective Programming
author: Luciano Ramalho
genres: Computer Science, Python, Programming, Software Engineering, Tech
description: Takes you on a journey through Python's unique data model, dunder methods, generators, coroutines with asyncio, meta-programming, and modern type hints to write truly Pythonic code.

title: The Rust Programming Language
author: Steve Klabnik, Carol Nichols
genres: Computer Science, Rust, Systems Programming, Memory Safety, Tech
description: The official guide to Rust, teaching ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, fearless concurrency, smart pointers, cargo packaging, and zero-cost abstractions.

title: The Mythical Man-Month: Essays on Software Engineering
author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
genres: Computer Science, Project Management, Software Engineering, Classic, Tech
description: Few books on software project management have been as influential. Brooks shares timeless wisdom on team communication, the 'second-system effect', and why adding manpower to a late software project makes it later.

title: Compilers: Principles, Techniques, and Tools (The Dragon Book)
author: Alfred V. Aho, Monica S. Lam, Ravi Sethi, Jeffrey D. Ullman
genres: Computer Science, Compilers, Parsing, Programming Languages, Tech
description: The landmark classic on compiler design, lexing, parsing, syntax-directed translation, intermediate code generation, and instruction optimization.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
genres: Science Fiction, Space Opera, Classic Sci-Fi, Fantasy
description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world where the only thing of value is the spice melange, a drug capable of extending life and enhancing consciousness.

title: Dune Messiah
author: Frank Herbert
genres: Science Fiction, Space Opera, Philosophical, Classic Sci-Fi
description: Twelve years after the events of Dune, Paul Atreides has become Emperor of the known universe, but a deadly conspiracy threatens his reign, religion, and the fate of humanity.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
genres: Science Fiction, Space Opera, Classic Sci-Fi, Hard Sci-Fi
description: The story of Hari Seldon and his psychohistory, a mathematical science capable of predicting the behavior of mass populations, and his Foundation established to preserve human knowledge during the Galactic Empire's collapse.

title: Foundation and Empire
author: Isaac Asimov
genres: Science Fiction, Space Opera, Classic Sci-Fi, Hard Sci-Fi
description: The Foundation battles the remnants of the Galactic Empire, only to face an unexpected threat: the mysterious mutant warlord known as the Mule.

title: Hyperion
author: Dan Simmons
genres: Science Fiction, Space Opera, Cyberpunk, Epic Sci-Fi
description: On the world called Hyperion, beyond the reach of galactic law, seven pilgrims share their interwoven tales as they journey to the mysterious Time Tombs guarded by the lethal creature called the Shrike.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
genres: Science Fiction, Cyberpunk, Dystopian, Sci-Fi
description: Case was the sharpest data-thief in the matrix until an ex-employer crippled his nervous system. Now a mysterious employer recruits him for a high-stakes hack against an unthinkably powerful artificial intelligence.

title: Snow Crash
author: Neal Stephenson
genres: Science Fiction, Cyberpunk, Dystopian, Satire
description: In reality, Hiro Protagonist delivers pizza for Uncle Enzo's CosoNostra Pizza. In the Metaverse, he is a warrior prince racing to stop a computer virus capable of infecting the human brain.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
genres: Science Fiction, Hard Sci-Fi, Survival, Adventure
description: Six days ago, astronaut Mark Watney became one of the first people to walk on Mars. Now, he's sure he'll be the first person to die there after a dust storm separates him from his crew.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
genres: Science Fiction, Hard Sci-Fi, Space Exploration, Adventure
description: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission—and if he fails, humanity and the earth itself will perish. Except right now, he doesn't even remember his own name.

title: The Three-Body Problem
author: Cixin Liu
genres: Science Fiction, Hard Sci-Fi, Alien Invasion, Physics
description: Set against the backdrop of China's Cultural Revolution, a secret military project sends signals into space to establish contact with aliens, leading to catastrophic consequences for Earth.

title: The Dark Forest
author: Cixin Liu
genres: Science Fiction, Hard Sci-Fi, Alien Invasion, Cosmic Horror
description: Humanity reels from the revelation of an incoming alien invasion force, deploying Wallfacers—individuals given immense resources to craft secret defense strategies hidden from alien observation.

title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
genres: Science Fiction, Military Sci-Fi, Classic Sci-Fi, Young Adult
description: In order to develop a secure defense against a hostile alien race's next attack, government agencies breed child prodigies and train them as military commanders in zero-gravity battle simulations.

title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
author: Philip K. Dick
genres: Science Fiction, Cyberpunk, Dystopian, Philosophy
description: By 2021, the World War has killed millions, driving entire species into extinction. Bounty hunter Rick Deckard stalks rogue Nexus-6 androids through the radioactive ruins of San Francisco.

title: Solaris
author: Stanislaw Lem
genres: Science Fiction, Philosophical, Psychological Sci-Fi, Classic Sci-Fi
description: Psychologist Kris Kelvin arrives on a space station studying the living plasma ocean of Solaris, discovering that the planet is capable of dredging up humans' deepest suppressed memories and manifesting them physically.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
genres: Science Fiction, Classic Sci-Fi, Feminist Sci-Fi, Sociology
description: A human envoy called Genly Ai is sent to Gethen, an icy world whose inhabitants can choose and change their gender, exploring themes of psychology, sociology, politics, and humanity.

title: Fahrenheit 451
author: Ray Bradbury
genres: Science Fiction, Dystopian, Classic, Literature
description: Guy Montag is a fireman whose job is to burn books, which are forbidden by law. But when he meets an eccentric young neighbor, he begins questioning everything he has been taught.

title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
genres: Science Fiction, Dystopian, Classic, Philosophy
description: A dark vision of a futuristic society governed by consumerism, genetic caste engineering, and psychological conditioning where pain and sorrow are eradicated by the drug soma.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
genres: Fantasy, High Fantasy, Adventure, Classic
description: Bilbo Baggins, a comfortable and unambitious hobbit, is swept away on a dangerous quest by the wizard Gandalf and thirteen dwarves to reclaim the Lonely Mountain and its treasure from the dragon Smaug.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
genres: Fantasy, High Fantasy, Epic Fantasy, Classic
description: Frodo Baggins inherits the One Ring of Power forged by the Dark Lord Sauron. To save Middle-earth from darkness, Frodo and a fellowship of companions must embark on a treacherous journey to destroy it in Mount Doom.

title: The Two Towers
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
genres: Fantasy, High Fantasy, Epic Fantasy, Classic
description: The Fellowship is scattered across Middle-earth. Aragorn, Legolas, and Gimli rally the kingdoms of men against Saruman's armies, while Frodo and Sam guided by Gollum trek toward Mordor.

title: The Return of the King
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
genres: Fantasy, High Fantasy, Epic Fantasy, Classic
description: The climactic war for Middle-earth reaches its peak at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields as Frodo and Sam navigate the horrors of Mordor to cast the Ring into the fire.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
genres: Fantasy, High Fantasy, Magic, Epic Fantasy
description: The tale of Kvothe, from his childhood in a troupe of traveling players to his years as a near-feral orphan in a crime-riddled city, to his daring brazen entrance into a legendary school of high magic.

title: The Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
genres: Fantasy, Epic Fantasy, High Fantasy, Magic System
description: Roshar is a world of stone and storms. Centuries have passed since the fall of the ten consecrated orders known as the Knights Radiant, but their Shardblades and Shardplate remain, coveted weapons in endless war.

title: Words of Radiance
author: Brandon Sanderson
genres: Fantasy, Epic Fantasy, High Fantasy, Magic System
description: Kaladin must protect the king while mastering the powers of a Windrunner, Shallan strives to prevent the return of the Voidbringers, and the Parshendi gamble everything on a forbidden magic.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
genres: Fantasy, High Fantasy, Heist, Magic System
description: In a world where ash falls from the sky and mist dominates the night, a charismatic thief named Kelsier recruits an orphan named Vin into a crew planning the impossible: overthrowing the immortal Lord Ruler.

title: A Game of Thrones
author: George R.R. Martin
genres: Fantasy, Epic Fantasy, Dark Fantasy, Political Drama
description: Summers span decades and winter can last a lifetime. Noble houses clash in a bitter struggle for the Iron Throne of Westeros while an ancient menace stirs in the frozen north.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
genres: Mystery, Thriller, Crime, Scandinavian Noir
description: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist and brilliant, rebellious computer hacker Lisbeth Salander investigate the forty-year-old disappearance of Harriet Vanger from a wealthy Swedish dynasty.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
genres: Mystery, Psychological Thriller, Crime, Suspense
description: On the morning of their fifth wedding anniversary, Amy Dunne suddenly disappears. Under intense police pressure and media frenzy, her husband Nick becomes the primary suspect in a maze of deception.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
genres: Psychological Thriller, Mystery, Suspense, Crime
description: Alicia Berenson's life is seemingly perfect. One evening she shoots her husband five times in the face and never speaks another word. Psychotherapist Theo Faber is determined to unravel her secret.

title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
genres: Mystery, Classic Mystery, Whodunit, Crime
description: Ten strangers are lured to an isolated island mansion off the Devon coast by a mysterious host. One by one, they are marked for death according to a sinister nursery rhyme.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
genres: Classic, Historical Fiction, Literature, Legal Drama
description: Set in the American South during the Depression, young Scout Finch watches her father Atticus defend a Black man falsely accused of raping a white woman, examining racism and morality.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
genres: Classic, Literature, Historical Fiction, Romance
description: The tragic story of Jay Gatsby, a mysterious millionaire with an obsession for the beautiful Daisy Buchanan, exploring the decadence and disillusionment of the Jazz Age.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
genres: Classic, Romance, Literature, Historical Fiction
description: Elizabeth Bennet navigates manners, social hierarchy, and matrimony in 19th-century England, clashing with the proud and enigmatic aristocrat Mr. Darcy.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez
genres: Magical Realism, Classic, Literature, Epic
description: The multi-generational story of the Buendia family in the mythical Colombian town of Macondo, blending historical reality with wondrous supernatural and magical realism.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J.D. Salinger
genres: Classic, Literature, Coming-of-Age, Fiction
description: Holden Caulfield wanders New York City for three days after being expelled from prep school, venting his frustrations about phoniness, alienation, and lost childhood innocence.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
genres: Classic, Gothic, Philosophical, Literature
description: Enthralled by his own youth and beauty, Dorian Gray sells his soul so that his portrait ages and bears the scars of his sins while he remains outwardly ageless and pure.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
genres: Classic, Gothic Horror, Science Fiction, Literature
description: Victor Frankenstein breathes life into a creature made of scavenged corpse parts, only to be horrified by what he created as the creature seeks vengeance for abandonment.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
genres: Non-Fiction, History, Anthropology, Science, Philosophy
description: From the cognitive revolution seventy thousand years ago to the genetic engineering revolution today, Harari explores how biology and history have defined what it means to be human.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
genres: Self-Help, Psychology, Productivity, Non-Fiction, Personal Growth
description: A comprehensive framework for improving every day. James Clear reveals how minute changes compound into remarkable results through habit loops, cues, craving, and environmental design.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
genres: Psychology, Non-Fiction, Behavioral Economics, Science
description: Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman explains the two systems that drive the way we think: System 1 (fast, intuitive, and emotional) and System 2 (slower, more deliberative, and more logical).

title: Meditations
author: Marcus Aurelius
genres: Philosophy, Stoicism, Classic, Non-Fiction
description: The private journal entries of the Roman Emperor Marcus Aurelius, offering timeless Stoic reflections on duty, mortality, resilience, and inner tranquility.

title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
genres: Finance, Psychology, Non-Fiction, Economics, Self-Help
description: Doing well with money isn't necessarily about what you know. It's about how you behave. Morgan Housel shares 19 short stories exploring the strange ways people think about money.

title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
genres: Fiction, Fantasy, Contemporary, Mental Health, Philosophy
description: Between life and death there is a library where every book provides a chance to try another life you could have lived. Nora Seed discovers what makes life truly fulfilling.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
author: Delia Owens
genres: Fiction, Mystery, Historical Fiction, Romance, Coming-of-Age
description: For years, rumors of the 'Marsh Girl' haunted Barkley Cove. When handsome Chase Andrews is found dead, the locals immediately suspect Kya Clark, the barefoot marsh girl who survived alone.

title: The Song of Achilles
author: Madeline Miller
genres: Historical Fiction, Mythology, Fantasy, Romance, LGBTQ+
description: A breathtaking retelling of the Trojan War focusing on the profound, tender bond between awkward prince Patroclus and the glorious demigod Achilles.

title: Klara and the Sun
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
genres: Science Fiction, Dystopian, Literary Fiction, Artificial Intelligence
description: From Nobel Prize laureate Kazuo Ishiguro, the story of Klara, an Artificial Friend with outstanding observational qualities, who watches the customers from a store window, hoping to be chosen.
